$:printf 'REV '; git rev-parse --short HEAD; printf '
TASK FILES
'; find Tasks -maxdepth 4 -type f -print | sort; printf '
CUSTOM INSTRUCTION MATCHES
'; grep -RinE 'custom.?instruction|personalization|end.of.turn|conversation analytics' Tasks --exclude-dir=.git | head -n 160; printf '
README CANDIDATES
'; find . -name README.md -o -name AGENTS.md | head -n 60
